desc: When you need that steady shot, you need to reach for your Cole-TAC Trap Bag. This versatile Trap rifle support bag allows you to take that long shot when you need it. Whether you need to rest on a barricade or use it as a rear bag, it forms over the object to make a flat smooth surface. The Trap Bag gets its name from the trapezoid shape it has when laying flat on the one side. The possibilities are endless as to how the Trap Bag can be used over different objects and surfaces. The best feature is how it is able to fold over objects and still provide a surface to balance your rifle. With its adaptable shape and durable construction, it'll keep your rifle steady no matter where it rests.
